VIJERON / COLOR DESK

Privacy policy

How Measured Color handles tool inputs, analytics, advertising and visitor consent choices.

Tool data

HEX codes and variation steps are calculated in the browser. This site does not transmit or store them on a Vijeron server.

Analytics

Google Analytics 4 may record page views and tool-use events. Events contain only tool name and language, not color codes or results.

Ads and consent

AdSense and Funding Choices scripts may load on content pages. Ad and analytics storage start denied until applicable consent choices are obtained. Google may process data under its service policies.

Contact

Use Vijeron's contact page for privacy questions and corrections.

Measured Color

A solid-pair checker and mathematical color variants, not a whole-page accessibility audit or aesthetic guarantee.
